# Apex Leads Pro

> Exclusive leads for contractors, insurance agents, and home service businesses.
> One buyer per lead. Never shared, never resold. From $20.

## What we do
Apex Leads Pro (https://apexleads.biz) sells exclusive, verified homeowner and consumer leads
to contractors and insurance agents. Every lead goes to exactly one buyer.

## Verticals
Roofing, HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Insurance, Landscaping, Painting, and more.

## Pricing
- $20 single lead trial
- $47 (3-pack), $97 (5-pack), $397 (10-pack), $850 (25-pack), $1497 (50-pack)
- Aged leads in bulk: 100 for $149 (3-month), 100 for $79 (6-month)
- Zone Lock: $697/mo for exclusive city + vertical rights

## Key differentiators
- 100% exclusive: one buyer per lead, never shared, never resold
- No contracts, no minimums, no sales call required
- Verified contact info with source URL on every lead
- Free replacement for bad contacts within 7 days
